user.title: Set up Vacuum Orchestrator
user.description: Create the global job queue. Robot profiles can be added after setup.

user.title: Add robot
user.description: Choose a registered vacuum. Advanced configuration accepts roles, supported modes, mappings, requirements and timeouts.

reconfigure.title: Configure robot
reconfigure.description: Choose a registered vacuum. Advanced configuration accepts roles, supported modes, mappings, requirements and timeouts.

robot_entity_missing.title: Robot entity missing
robot_entity_missing.description: Restore the original vacuum entity or remove its idle profile.

robot_configuration_incomplete.title: Robot configuration incomplete
robot_configuration_incomplete.description: Check room targets, map bindings and supported cleaning modes using get_robots and configure_robot.

room_area_missing.title: Room area missing
room_area_missing.description: Restore the HA area, reassign the room or disable it. History is retained.

recovery_required.title: Cleaning recovery required
recovery_required.description: Check get_queue recovery_targets. Verify the affected robot has stopped before resolve_recovery. No cleaning success is assumed.
